text: Wisconsin law creates the University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority as “a public body corporate and politic”.
short: The University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority is a Wisconsin public body corporate and politic

source.name: Wisconsin Statutes §233.02(1) (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov, via Wayback Machine)
source.note: Live page: https://docs.legis.wisconsin.gov/statutes/statutes/233/02 — docs.legis.wisconsin.gov did not answer from the research environment, so the statute was read via the Wayback Machine.
source.quote: There is created a public body corporate and politic to be known as the “University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority”.
